cases.repaired: Griffin is a hybrid model that mixes gated linear recurrences with local attention, matching the performance of Llama-2 while being trained on over 6 times fewer tokens arXiv:2402.19427.

Large language models often produce responses containing factual inaccuracies due to their reliance on parametric knowledge, a limitation that Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) aims to mitigate by augmenting models with external knowledge retrieval arXiv:2310.11511.

In-Context RALM avoids modifying the language model architecture by prepending grounding documents to the input, allowing the use of off-the-shelf retrievers without further training arXiv:2302.00083.

REPLUG treats the language model as a black box and augments it with a tunable retrieval model by prepending retrieved documents to the input arXiv:2301.12652.

FLARE is a method that iteratively uses a prediction of the upcoming sentence to anticipate future content, which is then utilized as a query to retrieve relevant documents if the sentence contains low-confidence tokens arXiv:2305.06983.

Self-RAG trains a single language model to adaptively retrieve passages on-demand and generate reflection tokens to critique its own retrieval and generation processes arXiv:2310.11511.
